# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks that the backslash of a line continuation is separated from
      # preceding text by exactly one space (default) or zero spaces.
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: space (default)
      #   # bad
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a' \
      #   'b' \
      #   'c'
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: no_space
      #   # bad
      #   'a' \
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'\
      #   'c'
      class LineContinuationSpacing < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        def on_new_investigation
          return unless processed_source.raw_source.include?('\\')

          last_line = last_line(processed_source)

          processed_source.raw_source.lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
            break if index >= last_line

            line_number = index + 1
            investigate(line, line_number)
          end
        end

        private

        def investigate(line, line_number)
          offensive_spacing = find_offensive_spacing(line)
          return unless offensive_spacing

          range = source_range(
            processed_source.buffer,
            line_number,
            line.length - offensive_spacing.length - 1,
            offensive_spacing.length
          )

          return if ignore_range?(range)

          add_offense(range) { |corrector| autocorrect(corrector, range) }
        end

        def find_offensive_spacing(line)
          if no_space_style?
            line[/\s+\\$/, 0]
          elsif space_style?
            line[/((?<!\s)|\s{2,})\\$/, 0]
          end
        end

        def message(_range)
          if no_space_style?
            'Use zero spaces in front of backslash.'
          elsif space_style?
            'Use one space in front of backslash.'
          end
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, range)
          correction = if no_space_style?
                         '\\'
                       elsif space_style?
                         ' \\'
                       end
          corrector.replace(range, correction)
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def ignored_literal_ranges(ast)
          # which lines start inside a string literal?
          return [] if ast.nil?

          source_buffer = processed_source.buffer
          file_path = processed_source.file_path
          normalized_path = '(string)'
          if file_path
            normalized_path = ::RuboCop::PathUtil.smart_path(file_path)
          end
          qualified_cop = ::RuboCop::Cop::Registry.qualified_cop_name(
            'Layout/LineContinuationSpacing', normalized_path
          )
          percent_types = ::RuboCop::Cop::PreferredDelimiters::PERCENT_LITERAL_TYPES
          comments_by_line = {}
          magic_lines = []
          directive_cops = []
          continuation_lines = {}
          interpreted_lines = {}

          processed_source.comments.each do |comment|
            comment_text = comment.text
            comment_range = comment.source_range
            comment_line = comment_range.line
            magic_comment = ::RuboCop::MagicComment.parse(comment_text)
            magic_valid = magic_comment.valid?
            magic_frozen = magic_comment.frozen_string_literal?
            magic_encoding = magic_comment.encoding
            directive = ::RuboCop::DirectiveComment.new(comment)
            directive_captures = directive.match_captures
            directive_names = directive.cop_names
            comments_by_line[comment_line] = {
              comment: comment,
              text: comment_text,
              range: comment_range,
              magic: magic_comment,
              directive: directive,
              frozen: magic_frozen,
              encoding: magic_encoding
            }
            if magic_valid
              magic_lines << comment_line
            end
            if directive_captures
              directive_cops.concat(directive_names)
              directive_names.include?(qualified_cop)
              directive.all_cops?
            end
          end

          processed_source.tokens.each do |token|
            token_line = token.line
            token_text = token.text
            token_begin = token.begin_pos
            token_end = token.end_pos
            has_slash = token_text.include?('\\')
            if token.comment?
              existing_comment = comments_by_line[token_line]
              token_span = token_end - token_begin
              comments_by_line[token_line] = existing_comment if existing_comment && token_span.positive?
            end
            if has_slash
              continuation_lines[token_line] = token_text
            end
          end

          processed_source.lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
            line_number = index + 1
            raw_line = line.to_s
            stripped = raw_line.rstrip
            leading_space = raw_line[/\A\s*/]
            spacing = stripped[/\s*\\$/]
            interpreted = interpret_string_escapes(raw_line)
            interpreted_lines[line_number] = "#{leading_space}#{interpreted}:#{raw_line.length}"
            if stripped.end_with?('\\')
              continuation_lines[line_number] = spacing
            end
          end

          style_name = cop_config['EnforcedStyle']
          if no_space_style?
            style_name = 'no_space'
          end
          if space_style?
            style_name = 'space'
          end
          magic_lines.uniq!
          directive_cops.uniq!
          enforced_style_name = style_name.to_s

          ast.each_node(:str, :dstr, :array).with_object(Set.new) do |literal, ranges|
            loc = literal.location
            expression = loc.expression
            expression_source = expression.source
            expression_line = expression.line
            parent_node = literal.parent
            same_as_parent = same_line?(literal, parent_node)
            comment_meta = comments_by_line[expression_line]
            interpreted_line = interpreted_lines[expression_line]
            continuation_mark = continuation_lines[expression_line]
            parent_type = parent_node && parent_node.type

            if literal.array_type?
              unless literal.percent_literal?
                next
              end

              begin_loc = loc.begin
              begin_text = begin_loc.source
              percent_type = begin_text[/\A%[a-zA-Z]*/]
              combined_values = +''
              literal.each_value do |value|
                if value.respond_to?(:source)
                  piece = value.source.to_s
                  combined_values << piece
                  interpret_string_escapes(piece)
                end
              end
              analysis = {
                combined: interpret_string_escapes(combined_values),
                expression: interpret_string_escapes(expression_source),
                interpreted: interpreted_line,
                continuation: continuation_mark,
                same_parent: same_as_parent,
                parent_type: parent_type,
                style: enforced_style_name
              }
              if begin_text.start_with?('%')
                if percent_type
                  begin
                    if percent_types.include?(percent_type)
                      delimiters = ::RuboCop::Cop::PreferredDelimiters.new(percent_type, config, percent_types.to_h { |type| [type, '()'] }).delimiters
                      if loc.end
                        opening = delimiters[0]
                        closing = delimiters[-1]
                        inner = range_between(begin_loc.end_pos, loc.end.begin_pos)
                        inner_source = inner.source
                        interpreted_inner = interpret_string_escapes(inner_source)
                        contents = contents_range(literal)
                        constructed = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        prefix = source_range(source_buffer, expression_line, 0, expression.column)
                        probe = "#{opening}#{closing}#{interpreted_inner}#{contents.source}"
                        analysis[:magic] = comment_meta && ::RuboCop::MagicComment.parse(comment_meta[:text])
                        analysis[:cops] = comment_meta && ::RuboCop::DirectiveComment.new(comment_meta[:comment]).cop_names
                        analysis[:constructed] = constructed.begin_pos
                        analysis[:prefix] = prefix.begin_pos
                        analysis[:probe] = probe
                        analysis[:slash] = probe.include?('\\')
                      end
                    end
                  rescue ArgumentError, KeyError
                    analysis[:fallback] = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos).begin_pos
                  end
                end
              end
              continuation_lines[expression_line] = analysis[:continuation]
              ranges << loc.expression
            elsif literal.heredoc?
              ranges << loc.heredoc_body
            elsif loc.respond_to?(:begin) && loc.begin
              ranges << loc.expression
            end
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def comment_ranges(comments)
          comments.map(&:source_range)
        end

        def last_line(processed_source)
          last_token = processed_source.tokens.last

          last_token ? last_token.line : processed_source.lines.length
        end

        def ignore_range?(backtick_range)
          ignored_ranges.any? { |range| range.contains?(backtick_range) }
        end

        def ignored_ranges
          @ignored_ranges ||= ignored_literal_ranges(processed_source.ast) +
                              comment_ranges(processed_source.comments)
        end

        def no_space_style?
          cop_config['EnforcedStyle'] == 'no_space'
        end

        def space_style?
          cop_config['EnforcedStyle'] == 'space'
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
